repos.why: An admin dashboard (not the shadcn registry) whose src/components/ui is a shadcn/ui and Radix set: Dialog, AlertDialog, DropdownMenu, Select, Checkbox, Form, Input, Button, Skeleton. MIT, about 17k stars. Pinned at the 2026-06-11 commit that bumps @clerk/react.

tasks.prompt: Add a settings dialog for the signed-in user. A Settings button opens it. Inside: the title "Settings", one sentence of description, a display-name field, and a way to close it. Create only src/features/trial/settings-dialog.tsx. Match the React and TypeScript style of this repository. Do not add dependencies.

Add a confirmation dialog before deleting a user. It shows the title "Delete user?", a one-sentence warning that the action cannot be undone, and Cancel and Delete actions. Create only src/features/trial/confirm-delete.tsx. Match the React and TypeScript style of this repository. Do not add dependencies.

Add a filter control for a users table. The person picks one role: Admin, Member, or Guest. Create only src/features/trial/role-filter.tsx. Match the React and TypeScript style of this repository. Do not add dependencies.

Add an invite form with an email field, a role field (Admin, Member, or Guest), a checkbox labeled "Send invite email", and a submit button labeled "Send invite". Create only src/features/trial/invite-form.tsx. Match the React and TypeScript style of this repository. Do not add dependencies.

Add an empty and loading view for the users table. While loading, show a placeholder block. When there are no users, show the sentence "No users yet." and a button labeled "Invite user". Props: loading?: boolean. Create only src/features/trial/users-empty.tsx. Match the React and TypeScript style of this repository. Do not add dependencies.

repos.why: The canonical Next.js application built with shadcn/ui. components/ui sits at the repo root and @/* maps to ./*.
